recap: Poole comes to Utterson at night, fearing foul play. They walk to Jekyll’s house, where servants huddle terrified. Poole leads Utterson to the cabinet; a changed voice refuses them. Poole claims Jekyll was murdered eight days ago and saw a masked dwarf—Mr. Hyde. Utterson resolves to break in. Poole strikes the door five times with an axe. Inside lies Hyde’s contorted body, a crushed phial nearby. They search for Jekyll but find only chemicals, a blasphemous book, a will naming Utterson, and a sealed packet. Utterson plans to read the documents and return before midnight.
